height_note: SOT-23 standard max 1.45 [mem]; not read from the drawing

supplies.VCC: 1.7-3.6 V; ramp faster than 3 V/ms or run one wake-and-sleep cycle after power-up (p5)

logic: 3.3 V bus direct, up to 1 MHz

i2c_addr.select: factory code: A 0x35, B 0x22, C 0x78, D 0x44; changeable by register (p16)

expander: HALL_INT (optional; if tied to GND instead set MASK_INTB=1, p4)

placement: A marked 'magnet probe' spot at a case edge, away from the slider magnets so they do not eat range (they only add a fixed offset: null it).
Its own field is nil, but do not put it next to the MMC5983MA just to share a spot: the magnets people bring to it will saturate the compass anyway.
notes: Variant: x2 = +-133/+-266 mT (strong magnets), x1 = +-40/+-80 mT (p17). B2 is the stocked x2 code: 411 pieces. Alternatives in stock: D2 0x44 (352, would then need the OPT4001 kept off 0x44: it is), A1 0x35 x1 range (3,159, $3.57), C1 0x78 x1 range (1,000, $0.85).
0x22 is also the FUSB302B address, but that is on I2C_P: no clash. If both ever share a bus, reprogram this one (register) or fit the A/C/D code.
